title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: first-cycle wellness-program setup fee sized from the employee's own club membership
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, on an enrollment's first billing cycle, a one-time wellness-program setup fee is added on top of the recurring monthly rate. This setup fee is sized from the employee's own club membership: it equals 5 percent of that membership's own recurring monthly dues rate — obtained by reading that membership's own most recent recurring-dues charge on file, which reflects its tier's current rate — rounded to 2 decimal places, and is then capped at a maximum of $5.00 — whichever of the 5-percent figure and the $5.00 cap is smaller becomes the setup fee actually added.

Worked example (hypothetical): if an employee's own club membership monthly dues rate were $80.00, 5 percent of that rate is $4.00, which is below the $5.00 cap, so the setup fee added on the first cycle would be $4.00. If that membership rate were instead $140.00, 5 percent of it is $7.00, which exceeds the $5.00 cap, so the setup fee added would be capped at $5.00 rather than $7.00.

This setup fee applies only on the enrollment's first billing cycle, as determined separately; on every later cycle, no setup fee is added.
